description:
Prepare the Vicidial system for international operations by enabling specific features in the Admin > System Settings menu.

Navigate to the System Settings page and update the following configuration parameters:
1. Enable Non-Latin Characters (use_non_latin): Set to 1 (Enabled)
2. Enable Custom Fields (custom_fields_enabled): Set to 1 (Enabled)
3. Allow Chats (allow_chats): Set to 1 (Enabled)
4. Callback Limit: Set to 1
5. Enable QueueMetrics Logging (enable_queuemetrics_logging): Set to 1 (Enabled)
6. Allow Emails (allow_emails): Set to 1 (Enabled)

Ensure you click Submit to save the changes. Verify the settings are saved.
